Violent crime is falling in Alaska as President Trump’s law-and-order agenda delivers results for Alaska communities.

  • Juneau recorded a 6% decline in total criminal offenses last year.

President Trump and Republicans are delivering America First policies that put Alaska first: lower taxes, responsible resource development, safer communities, and major investments in the state’s military and economic future. Alaskans face a clear choice between continuing this progress, or returning to the higher taxes, energy restrictions, and open border policies of the past.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Today at the Science: A New Golden Age Summit, President Donald J. Trump presented National Medals of Science and National Medals of Technology and Innovation, our nation’s highest honors for exemplary achievement and leadership in science and technology, to six of America’s greatest living innovators.
 
Since 1963, the President of the United States has bestowed the National Medal of Science on those deserving of special recognition for their outstanding contributions to science in service of the United States. Since it was first awarded in 1985, the National Medal of Technology and Innovation has recognized American innovators whose vision, intellect, creativity, and determination have strengthened America’s economy and improved our quality of life.

President Trump is committed to restoring U.S. global scientific and technological leadership for a New Golden Age, from harnessing super intelligence for scientific discovery to ushering in a nuclear renaissance; from ensuring American space superiority to strengthening America’s quantum advantage.

These medalists have pioneered breakthroughs in science and engineering for the new age of super intelligence, from fundamental advances in general-purpose parallel computing and semiconductor design to engineering and business leadership in building the foundations of hyperscale infrastructure in the U.S., around the world, and even into space. Their work has advanced American global technology leadership for the 21st Century and laid the foundation for a new Golden Age of Science.

The recipients are listed below. 

Recipients of the National Medal of Science

  • Elon Musk – “For engineering achievements of extraordinary ambition and scale that have pushed the frontiers of space exploration, intelligent systems, communications, and beyond, renewing American technological leadership and opening a new chapter in American manufacturing.”
  • Sergey Brin – “For the development of foundational algorithms for information retrieval and data processing that revolutionized how the world accesses information across science, commerce, and in the course of everyday life.” 
  • Jensen Huang – “For advancing the graphics processing unit into a general-purpose computing architecture through innovations in processor design and software, transforming massively parallel computation and powering breakthroughs in scientific computing and super intelligence.”
  • Lisa Su – “For a lifetime of leadership in semiconductor engineering and high-performance computing through innovations in processor architecture and chiplet-based integration that powered the world’s first exascale supercomputer and opened new frontiers in computational performance.”

Recipients of the National Medal of Technology and Innovation

  • Michael Dell – “For advancing a vision of widespread adoption of personal and enterprise computing; for his technical and business management skills building a worldwide technology company; and for his support for the next generation of American scientists, engineers, and technologists.”
  • Satya Nadella – “For his transformative leadership of a critical American technology company, which led to its rejuvenation for a new era of cloud computing, and for his construction of the hyperscale infrastructure that enabled the training and global deployment of American super intelligence.”

 “Each of these medalists has transformed their field or industry, laying the foundations for technologies we already can barely imagine living without,” said Michael Kratsios, Assistant to the President and Director of the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy. “While we in government work to deliver the efforts a New Golden Age of Science will require, we know that scientific progress and technological innovation depend on the insight and character of individuals. Innovators like these six awardees are the architects of the future.”

About the Science: A New Golden Age Summit:

Science: A New Golden Age, released in July 2026 by White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Director Michael Kratsios, is the first comprehensive rethinking of the U.S. science and technology enterprise since Vannevar Bush’s 1945 Science: The Endless Frontier.

The report observes significant changes to how scientific discovery happens today, particularly the increased role of industry in driving R&D and the close integration of applied and foundational research. It provides concrete recommendations for how government, industry, academia, and philanthropy can seize the opportunities presented by these changes to accelerate scientific discovery and empower the Nation’s best and brightest scientists. Core recommendations include strengthening support for early-career scientists, reviving the national pursuit of ambitious scientific missions, launching new funding and organizational models for transformative research, building the metascience infrastructure to continuously improve the research enterprise, and scaling SI-driven scientific discovery through the Genesis Mission.

The Science: A New Golden Age Summit convenes leading scientists and innovators to examine these changes and translate the report’s ideas into the next chapter of American scientific progress. Throughout the day, the Trump Administration will provide major announcements, in coordination with private sector partners and research institutions, to realize the vision of Science: A New Golden Age and the Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science.

Trump Accounts—tax-advantaged investment accounts for kids—are a game-changing tool designed to help every American child build savings and a stronger financial future.

With automatic enrollment now complete, the Trump Administration has made it easier than ever for families to participate and give their children a jump-start on the American Dream. Nearly 70 million Trump Accounts have now been created, including more than 60 million through automatic enrollment, giving every American child under 18, with a Social Security number, an account in their name. Now, parents or guardians just have to claim their child’s Trump Account on the Trump Accounts App and unlock what’s waiting for their child.

Today, President Donald J. Trump celebrated this historic milestone alongside Trump Account recipients, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, IRS CEO Frank Bisignano, philanthropists Michael and Susan Dell, and Brad Gerstner, whose historic contributions have helped fund millions of Trump Accounts. 

“Today we celebrate our next historic, and that’s really what it is, step to ensure every American child has a fair shot at the American dream. Today I’m pleased to announce that every single eligible minor child in America has now been automatically enrolled in a Trump account. So last summer I signed the great Big, Beautiful Bill delivering the largest tax cuts in American history, and that included in there, approved by Republicans… the Trump accounts. And under this program, the U.S. government is automatically creating a tax-free investment account for every child to grow over the course of their lives and to be used to their benefit and for their benefit after they turn 18.” – President Donald J. Trump

Trump Accounts By The Numbers:

  • Nearly 70 million Trump Accounts have been created, with more than 60 million through automatic enrollment. The Trump Administration’s automatic enrollment has created millions of Trump Accounts, making it easier than ever for families to help secure their children’s financial futures. Every American child under 18 with a valid Social Security number now has a Trump Account in their name.
  • Parents and guardians simply need to claim their child’s account through the Trump Accounts App. Claiming an account allows parents to manage it, unlock contributions from family and friends, and receive the one-time $1,000 seed contribution from for eligible children.
  • Trump Accounts are already investing billions of dollars for American children. Since their launch on July 4th, more than $4.5 billion has been deposited into Trump Accounts, including $1.3 billion in $1,000 seed contributions, over $600 million in direct contributions from family and friends, and $2.6 billion in philanthropic gifts—with more on the way.
  • Trump Accounts are reaching hardworking families across the country. An estimated 80% of accounts are linked to families earning less than $200,000 annually, putting the opportunity to build long-term savings and wealth within reach for millions of Americans.
  • Families, employers, and philanthropists can all help children build their accounts. Family and friends can contribute up to $5,000 per year; employers can contribute up to $2,500 per year, subject to the overall $5,000 annual contribution limit, and children can qualify for philanthropic contributions that are automatically deposited into their accounts. To date, more than 70 companies have already committed to Trump Account contributions for their employees.
  • Trump Accounts give children a financial foundation that can grow with them. Over time, children can watch their balance grow from a couple of thousand dollars in kindergarten to an estimated half a million dollars by retirement—while learning essential financial skills like saving, investing, compound growth, and diversification.

Trump Accounts are made possible by President Trump and Republicans’ historic Working Families Tax Cuts legislation. These tax-advantaged investment accounts— that every single Democrat voted against— are giving millions of kids a head start on building wealth and a financial stake in their future.

Here’s what they’re saying:

President Donald J. Trump: “Today, I am announcing another unprecedented step to bring down costs. For many years, farm vehicles, construction equipment, and other off-road vehicles have used what is known as ‘red dye’ diesel… which is exactly the same as normal diesel, but is sold tax-free for off-road vehicles and big trucks… Tonight, I am going to sign a historic Executive Order to officially waive the off-road requirement and allow anyone to purchase tax-free red dye diesel for any reason.”

Vice President JD Vance: “Another example of President Trump acting quickly to tackle an urgent issue. In this administration, we’re fighting every day to help hard working Americans, especially our farmers.”

White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles: “President Trump signed an Executive Order right here in Nebraska to lower diesel costs for American farmers, truckers, and workers. By expanding access to red-dyed diesel and providing federal tax relief, President Trump is once again taking decisive action to put money back in the pockets of hardworking Americans. Promises made. Promises kept.”

Secretary of Agriculture Brooke Rollins: “President Trump is the most pro ranching and farming president in our lifetime. Energy dominance is at the core of putting farmers and ranchers first. This administration has unleashed American energy dominance, and we are now the largest energy producer in the world as a result. While the Administration has structurally changed the energy sector to secure the long-term future of agriculture, we are now taking steps to deal with short term pressures impacting our American farmers. Thank you, President Trump for signing today’s Executive Order enacting enforcement discretion on on-road use of dyed diesel, which will better enable our farmers to deliver America’s harvest during this critical time. And I want to thank Vice President Vance for his help shepherding it to the end.”

American Farm Bureau Federation President Zippy Duvall: “We thank President Trump for recognizing that what happens at the fuel pump directly affects what happens on the farm and therefore at dinner tables across America. Allowing dyed diesel fuel to be used over-the-road will bring welcome relief for farmers because every cent per gallon matters when you’re running a fleet of grain trucks or hauling cattle hundreds of miles. As we detailed in a letter to the president last week, this effort will bring much needed price relief for farmers as they work to complete harvest across the U.S. The federal highway diesel tax is currently more than 24-cents per gallon, so it’s a big deal to farmers to be able to use tax exempt diesel more broadly to get their harvest to market. We appreciate that the president listened to farmers and responded.”

American Soybean Association Vice President Dave Walton: “As U.S. soybean farmers move the 2026 harvest to market, ASA thanks President Trump for his Executive Order that seeks to address high fuel costs impacting our bottom lines. This policy will align with actions taken by many soybean-producing states already, and ASA is encouraged by the administration’s continued focus on agricultural affordability.”

Missouri Gov. Mike Kehoe: “Last week, I signed an executive order taking targeted action to help address the unique fuel and transportation needs of harvest season in Missouri. President Trump’s action yesterday provides commonsense flexibility to lower transportation costs and keep agriculture moving across the entire nation. When we can reduce unnecessary costs for our farmers, that ultimately benefits families across our state and nation.”

Louisiana Gov. Jeff Landry: “Thank you, President @realDonaldTrump! I declared a State of Emergency so our farmers could use the dyed diesel fuel they already had on hand—and now, thanks to YOU, that relief is going nationwide! This is a HUGE WIN for America’s farmers, truckers, and hardworking families. Lower costs and real relief for the people who keep this country moving.”

Tennessee Gov. Bill Lee: “On Friday, I directed TN state departments to suspend enforcement of dyed diesel restrictions through the end of October to provide relief for farmers & foresters during harvest season. Thank you, @RealDonaldTrump, for standing with the Tennesseans who feed & fuel our country.”

Nebraska Gov. Jim Pillen: “This action expands on state efforts I enacted by executive order just a few weeks ago. This will greatly assist farmers who are dealing with extraordinarily high diesel prices, impacting everything they do – from field operations to transportation of their products and livestock. I appreciate that President Trump signed his order today in Nebraska. Agriculture is the tip of the spear in our great state, and we need to continue to do all that we can to feed the world and save the planet. President Trump knows that and we appreciate his support.”

Mississippi Gov. Tate Reeves: “President Trump has announced he is signing an executive order that will defer the federal excise tax on dyed diesel and allow for highway use. Because of the EO signed by @POTUS, I have spoken with Commissioner @TindellSean and he plans to direct the Commercial Transportation Enforcement Division of the Mississippi Department of Public Safety to not enforce the dyed diesel prohibition on highways. Thanks to this executive order and Commissioner Tindell’s swift action, much-needed relief will be delivered to our nation’s farmers, truckers, ranchers and loggers, as well as a wide range of other industries that rely on diesel. This will have positive ripple effects on America’s economy and your wallet. I’d like to thank President Trump and his administration for working quickly to provide this relief.”

Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds: “Today, in line with President Trump’s executive order, I suspended state penalties for using dyed diesel to transport certain ag products on public roads. This will lower costs for farmers through the harvest and beyond by opening access to tax-free fuel.”

South Dakota Gov. Larry Rhoden: “In response to these extraordinary times, President Trump has ordered a suspension of enforcement of the federal dyed diesel fuel for taxpayers on highways and public roads. Therefore, I am directing the Department of Public Safety to adjust enforcement priorities regarding the use of dyed diesel fuel. Many farmers maintain on-site supplies of dyed diesel fuel for nontaxable, off-road use. By taking this action, we will provide meaningful relief to South Dakota farmers. Similarly, President Trump’s order will allow all taxpayers to realize meaningful savings from using dyed diesel.”

North Carolina Gov. Josh Stein: “Last week I took action to help provide some relief at the pump for North Carolina’s farmers, and I asked the IRS to step in to pause enforcement of the red-dyed diesel tax at the federal level. I am pleased to see farmers across the country will now get this same relief. Let’s keep working at every level of government to help people keep more money in their wallets.”

Tennessee Commissioner of Agriculture Andy Holt: “Governor Lee’s directive, coupled with President Trump’s federal executive order, provides timely relief for Tennessee farmers, forest product producers and timber harvesters facing high diesel costs during harvest season. Agriculture and forestry are essential to Tennessee’s economy, and this temporary flexibility will help keep producers working, products moving, and rural communities supported. We appreciate Governor Lee’s leadership, President Trump’s action, and Secretary Rollins’ support for American agriculture.”

Kentucky Commissioner of Agriculture Jonathan Shell: “Huge win for Kentucky farmers. President Trump signed an executive order expanding access to tax-exempt red-dyed diesel. With harvest underway and high fuel costs weighing on farm families, this will provide immediate relief and help lower costs. Thank you President Trump for standing with our farmers.”

Mississippi Commissioner of Agriculture and Commerce Andy Gipson: “A HUGE thank you to President Trump and Governor Reeves for taking action to allow red-dyed off-road diesel fuel. A huge help to our farmers, loggers and truckers here in Mississippi and across America.”

Alabama Farmers Federation President Jimmy Parnell: “We appreciate President Trump joining Gov. Kay Ivey in allowing dyed diesel fuel to be used without penalty for highway use. With about a dozen states easing enforcement of off-road diesel rules, President Trump’s executive order provides consistency across the country and ensures farmers and timber producers will not be penalized when they cross state lines to market their products.”

Louisiana Farm Bureau President Richard Fontenot: “Anything helps, especially as we work to get the crops out of the fields. I’m appreciative of the governor’s (and president’s) efforts to give us any relief during this time.”

Tennessee Farm Bureau Federation: “We join American Farm Bureau President @ZippyDuvall in applauding the executive order signed by President Trump to suspend enforcement of dyed diesel fuel restrictions for agricultural operators, giving farmers a break.”

Sen. Tom Cotton: “Allowing on-road use of red diesel will give Arkansas farmers much-needed relief. This is a welcome step by the administration that I’ve long called for.”

Sen. Chuck Grassley: “Thx to Pres Trump for listening to farmers & temporarily allowing off-road dyed diesel for highway use Lowering costs for FARMERS DURING HARVEST”

Sen. Bill Hagerty: “@POTUS is taking action to lower diesel prices, cutting costs for Tennessee farmers who keep food moving from the farm to families’ dinner tables.”

Sen. Roger Marshall: “Temporary expanded use of dyed diesel allows producers to utilize more fuel options during harvest and lightens the cost of production for farmers and ranchers at a crucial time. Thanks to the White House for listening to farmers. We still have more work to do.”

Sen. Mike Rounds: “Following my letter last week, I’m pleased to see that the President is taking steps to lower fuel prices, including a review of certain taxes on diesel. This is an opportunity to offer real relief to South Dakotans who continue to pay higher prices at the pump, particularly farmers and ranchers who are in the middle of harvest. We’ll continue to work on addressing the high cost of living impacting our state.”

Rep. Mark Alford: “@POTUS just signed an order letting truckers and farmers run tax-free dyed diesel on the highway through year’s end — no interest, no penalties. That puts real money back in the pockets of the folks who haul our freight and grow our food.”

Rep. Tim Burchett: “A few weeks ago, I called on @POTUS to take action on diesel prices. Last night, President Trump signed an Executive Order to put money back in the pockets of American farmers, truckers, and workers.”

Rep. Don Davis: “It’s a much needed Executive Order that provides temporary relief for farmers and working families facing record fuel costs.”

Rep. Russell Fry: “No one cares more about affordability than President Trump and Congressional Republicans.”

Rep. Ashley Hinson: “High diesel prices are hurting our truckers, farmers, and all Iowans, and this executive order is a step in the right direction to deliver relief. We should be using every tool available to lower fuel prices and provide flexibility for Iowa farmers during harvest season. I’ll continue to push for bipartisan policies that lower costs at the pump and the checkout line.”

Rep. Rich McCormick: “A farmer can’t wait for prices to come down. The crop is in the field right now. This week @POTUS signed an order that temporarily allows tax-free dyed diesel to be used on the highway. The federal diesel tax is deferred through the end of the year, with no interest and no penalties. That’s about $60 on a 250-gallon fill, and more where states follow suit. It’s temporary, and it’s not the whole answer. But for the families who feed America, it is real relief at a critical time. The long-term fix is more supply and more refining capacity. That is the work still ahead.”

Rep. Zach Nunn: “This is a good first step and it will deliver real relief for farmers facing record diesel prices in the middle of harvest.”

Rep. Jason Smith: “I applaud President Trump’s executive order today to provide immediate relief by deferring the excise tax for on-road use of dyed diesel until the end of the year. This executive order is only a first step — it is crucial to provide lasting relief for the hardworking Americans who feed, fuel, and clothe our nation.”

Rep. Greg Steube: “President Trump is delivering relief for America’s farmers and truckers. My RED Fuel Act is sitting in Congress waiting to make this relief permanent. House Leadership needs to bring us back to D.C. and pass it!”

Tonight, President Donald J. Trump signed an Executive Order to immediately cut diesel costs for the truckers and farmers who keep America moving. The order temporarily opens highway use of tax-free dyed diesel, deferring the federal diesel tax on that fuel through the end of the year — no interest, no penalties.

With elevated diesel prices and tightened global supply driven by the Russia-Ukraine war and a lack of refining capacity around the world, this is President Trump’s affordability agenda in action.

The federal diesel tax is 24.4 cents per gallon, or about $60 on a 250-gallon fill. Where states match this federal action, savings will top $100 per fill — a real difference for the hardworking Americans who haul the freight and grow the food.

Today, President Donald J. Trump travels to Grand Island, Nebraska. Under President Trump and Republican leadership, families in the Cornhusker State are keeping more of what they earn, farmers and ranchers are getting direct support, private investment is expanding production, and crime is falling in the state’s largest cities.

Historic Tax Relief for Nebraskans

President Trump’s Working Families Tax Cuts stopped the largest tax hike in American history and put money back in Nebraskans’ pockets.

  • No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime: Qualified tips and overtime pay are now deductible from federal income taxes, benefiting hundreds of thousands of Nebraska service workers, truckers, manufacturers, and hourly employees.
  • No Tax on Social Security: More than 300,000 Nebraska seniors can benefit from the new deduction that eliminates federal income tax on Social Security benefits for the vast majority of recipients.
  • Bigger refunds: Nebraskans’ average federal tax refund reached $3,378.
  • Investments in rural health: Nebraska secured nearly $219 million in first-year funding under the Working Families Tax Cuts’ Rural Health Transformation Program — the eighth-largest award in the country — to modernize care in rural communities.
  • Protecting Nebraska’s economy: The Working Families Tax Cuts protected 37,000 Nebraska jobs, preserved $7 billion in state GDP, and safeguarded $3 billion in wages for Nebraskans.

Standing with Nebraska Farmers and Ranchers

President Trump’s America First agenda is delivering real dollars and new market access to the producers who feed the country.

  • Year-round E15: In April 2025, President Trump’s EPA granted the emergency waiver that cleared summer sales of E15 nationwide, answering the direct request of Nebraska and other Midwestern states and expanding the market for Nebraska ethanol and corn.
  • Direct aid: USDA has delivered $622 million to 36,000 Nebraska Farmers through the Emergency Commodity Assistance Program for the 2024 crop year. Nebraska farmers have also received more than $632 million in Farmer Bridge Assistance payments — part of the $12 billion national bridge program for trade disruptions and higher input costs left by the Biden Administration — with nearly 33,000 Nebraska producers applying. They remain eligible for the $16 billion Supplemental Disaster Relief Program covering 2023 and 2024 crop losses.
  • Ranchers first: In September 2026, President Trump signed two Executive Orders backing American ranchers. One directs action to help producers protect herds from wolves and other predators, and advances country-of-origin labeling transparency. The second orders tougher enforcement of the Packers and Stockyards Act and expands ranchers’ ability to get cattle to market without compromising food safety.

New Investment Across Nebraska

President Trump’s economic agenda is delivering major private-sector investment and expansion.

  • Eaton is investing more than $30 million in a new Bellevue facility to expand U.S. production of medium-voltage switchgear for data centers, creating more than 200 new jobs.
  • Becton Dickinson is investing $110 million to expand prefillable syringe production at its Columbus plant, creating about 120 new jobs, on top of its earlier $35 million investment at the same plant.

Safer Communities for Nebraskans

President Trump’s commitment to law and order is producing real drops in crime in Nebraska’s largest cities.

  • In Omaha, crime is down from last year, including an 11% drop in total crime, a 12% drop in property crime, a 33% drop in criminal homicide, a 21% drop in rape, a 31% drop in robbery, and a 29% drop in auto theft.
  • In Lincoln, violent crime is down 15%, robbery is down 31%, aggravated assault is down 16%, murder is down 75%, and property crime is down 9%.

President Trump is in Nebraska to deliver a simple message: promises made, promises kept. Lower taxes, stronger farms and ranches, new manufacturing, and safer streets are the record because Republicans delivered — and Nebraskans cannot afford to hand that progress back.

KYOTO, JAPAN — At the 23rd Annual Meeting of the Science and Technology in Society (STS) Forum convened in Kyoto, the United States and 16 countries endorsed the Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science. The joint declaration reflects a shared ambition  to renew and strengthen our science ecosystems and usher in a golden age of discovery and prosperity.

Led by White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Director Michael Kratsios, the Kyoto Vision recognizes that we stand at the frontier of an immense opportunity to harness super intelligence and advance new approaches to greatly accelerate scientific discovery. Super intelligence for science will enable autonomous experimentation at scale, unlocking new experimental and analytical capabilities that open entirely new lines of inquiry. In light of the profound shifts in the research landscape, ministers pledged to seize this moment by harnessing new institutional models and funding mechanisms to enable the best and brightest scientists to pursue their most ambitious work. 

“The way we make scientific discoveries has changed, and the Kyoto Vision is a recognition of that shift and a call to action,” said Director Kratsios. “Super intelligence applied to science will be the greatest force in history for democratizing research. Seizing this moment requires us to reinvigorate our research enterprises and leverage new institutional models for discovery. Under President Trump’s leadership, the United States is leading that charge, and the Kyoto Vision shows the world is ready to move forward with us.”

The Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science calls for:

  • Improving the institutions of discovery: Ministers noted the value of a using a variety of funding tools to support research, including long-duration awards, rapid grants, and prizes and challenges, and encouraged experimentation with new institutional models that offer different levels of autonomy, resources, and direction. They welcomed metascience as an empirical field to improve how science is conducted, organized, and funded for public benefit.
  • Harnessing super intelligence for science: Ministers recognized that SI is both accelerating existing research tasks and enabling entirely new forms of inquiry. They encouraged thoughtful integration of SI into scientific workflows and pledged to expand researcher access to SI for science tools, scientific data, computing infrastructure, and experimental facilities.
  • Cultivating talent across the scientific enterprise: Ministers committed to identifying and investing in meritorious students and early-career researchers, and to giving them the support, freedom, and opportunity necessary for ambitious inquiry. They acknowledged that progress in many technological domains depends on people who can operate, maintain, and improve instrumentation, and encouraged expanded hands-on training as well as cross-sectoral doctoral programs, fellowships, and research partnerships.

In July 2026, Director Kratsios delivered to President Trump Science: A New Golden Age, the most comprehensive rethinking of the American science and technology research enterprise in eight decades. The report established new directions for U.S. government agencies on how they conduct, fund, and measure the impact of R&D, in light of fundamental changes to the American scientific enterprise and the new opportunities that have emerged.

The following countries endorsed the Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science:

Chile
Cyprus
Germany
Greece
Indonesia
Italy
Japan
Kazakhstan
Republic of Korea

On Day One, President Donald J. Trump promised to “move with purpose and speed to bring back hope, prosperity, safety, and peace.” Nearly two years into his second term, he has done exactly that — delivering results at a pace Washington has never seen.

Here are 32 landmark policy wins from the past few weeks alone:

  • President Trump clawed back nearly $1 billion in wasteful spending aimed at illegal aliens and DEI programs.
  • The Department of State surpassed 250,000 visa revocations, tightening vetting and removing criminal illegal aliens.
  • President Trump launched America.gov, a first-of-its-kind platform putting government services and information directly in Americans’ hands.
  • President Trump secured a $15 billion Iowa steel mill set to add $95 billion to the economy, produce up to 10 million tons of steel per year, and create thousands of permanent jobs.
  • The Department of the Treasury began sending Obamacare refund checks to nearly one million Americans who were overcharged under the Biden Administration.
  • The Department of the Treasury announced that more than 60 million children have been automatically enrolled in Trump Accounts.
  • The Department of the Treasury sanctioned 21 individuals and 25 companies tied to the Sinaloa Cartel.
  • The Department of Education formally rescinded the Biden Administration’s illegal Title IX rewrite.
  • The Department of Energy announced nearly $2 billion for grid upgrades across the country.
  • The Department of Transportation finalized new vehicle efficiency standards that will save Americans nearly $140 billion over five years.
  • The Department of Commerce locked in a $1.6 billion advanced manufacturing investment in Texas.
  • The Department of State secured a historic agreement to develop Nigeria’s $700 billion worth of mineral resources.
  • The Department of State imposed new visa restrictions to combat birth tourism and protect U.S. citizenship.
  • The White House budget office moved to reshore production of 86 essential medicines, including penicillin, epinephrine, and ibuprofen.
  • Federal regulators authorized the Kosciusko Junction pipeline to deliver an extra 1.2 billion cubic feet of natural gas per day to the Southeast.
  • The Department of the Interior completed a Utah oil and gas lease sale that brought in nearly $5 million, with Trump-era revenues already exceeding the entire Biden term.
  • The Departments of Commerce and Energy secured a ten-year LNG supply deal between Lithuania’s Ignitis and U.S. producer EQT.
  • The Department of State facilitated a landmark deal for Biman Bangladesh Airlines to purchase 11 additional Boeing aircraft.
  • The Department of the Treasury expanded tax-payment flexibility for American farmers.
  • The Office of Personnel Management uncovered $500 million in fraud and waste in federal health benefit programs.

  • Health officials awarded $3 million to develop new ways to cut tick populations and fight Lyme and alpha-gal.

  • President Trump’s Memphis Safe Task Force surpassed 13,100 criminal arrests and 2,200 illegal gun seizures, while his D.C. Safe and Beautiful Task Force neared 18,000 arrests and more than 2,100 illegal gun seizures.
  • First Lady Melania Trump secured partnerships with Adobe, Amazon, Intel, Starlink, Google, and Zoom to expand technology and education for children through her Fostering the Future Together initiative.

From reshoring critical industries and cutting waste to crushing crime and protecting taxpayers, President Trump is delivering the agenda Americans elected him to pursue — and he’s not slowing down.

President Donald J. Trump announced a $15 billion Mesabi Metallics steel complex is coming to Iowa — the largest steel plant ever built in the United States as more industrial capacity comes home. The project will create 1,750 new, permanent jobs, support up to 6,000 construction jobs, and generate an estimated $95 billion in U.S. economic output over construction and the first decade of operations.

Iowa leaders are heralding the “transformational” investment:

Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds: “I want to thank President Trump for his commitment to bringing steel manufacturing back to America, and Mesabi Metallics for choosing Iowa as its partner and future home. This is a transformational opportunity for our country, our state, and American families—one that strengthens national security, creates thousands of high-paying jobs, and provides a reliable supply of high-quality, American-made steel for strategic goods and everyday products. Our commitment in Iowa to fiscal responsibility, tax competitiveness, and long-term economic stability has created one of the nation’s strongest environments for business investment. Now, this opportunity will fundamentally change the economic trajectory of our state and the entire region for decades to come.”

Iowa Attorney General Brenna Bird: “This massive investment is the largest steel plant project in U.S. History. It means over 1,750 good-paying, family-supporting, steel working jobs for Southeast Iowa. This announcement is not just good news for Iowa, it’s good for the entire country. Thanks to President Trump for his leadership and continued commitment to American jobs for American citizens and to Governor Reynolds for her hard work bringing this great opportunity to Iowa.”

Sen. Chuck Grassley: “GR8 NEWS Mesabi Metallics will build a $15 BILLION steel mill in IA Remember GOP is working 2 bring down costs 4 families + create jobs This historic investment is AMERICA FIRST+builds on success of our Working Families Tax Cuts law which also prevented largest tax increase ever”

Sen. Joni Ernst: “Proud to join @POTUS today announcing a historic $15 BILLION investment in eastern Iowa, the largest steel plant in American history, and over 1700 permanent jobs in Iowa! Thank you, President Trump, for bringing jobs, investment, and American manufacturing back home!”

Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks: “For too long, Iowa families have watched their jobs shipped overseas and their communities hollowed out. Not anymore. The largest steel plant in America is coming to Lee County with more than 1,700 permanent, good-paying jobs. I’m proud to have helped make this historic investment a reality. There’s no better place than Iowa to make things IN America, BY Americans.”

Rep. Ashley Hinson: “This will be a game-changing investment for our state — creating 1,700 jobs & incredible opportunities for growth. There is no better place to invest and build than in Iowa because we have the best people.”

Rep. Zach Nunn: “This is a major opportunity for Southeast Iowa: Mesabi Metallics’ proposed $15 billion investment in Lee County could support 1,700 good-paying jobs and produce American steel right here in Iowa. We’ve worked to bring manufacturing home and secured nearly $5 million to strengthen skilled trades training at DMACC, Iowa Western, and Indian Hills. Now, we need to make sure Iowa workers have the skills to be first in line for these jobs and ready to build the next generation of American steel.”

Iowa Congressional Delegation: “This historic investment is a major win for Iowa workers and further cements Iowa’s role in the future of American manufacturing. As the largest steel plant investment in U.S. history, this project will generate over 1,700 good-paying Iowa jobs, create new opportunities for Iowa families, and drive economic growth. Iowa has the workforce, work ethic, resources, and business climate to compete with anyone, and we are proud to welcome this project to our state. The administration’s pro-American manufacturing policies are incentivizing companies to invest, build, and create jobs in the U.S. We thank Governor Reynolds for her leadership in making Iowa a great place to do business and ensuring our state benefits from these policies by attracting transformational investments like this one.”

Iowa Speaker of the House Pat Grassley: “This project would be a gamechanger for southeast Iowa and leave a lasting impact on our state’s manufacturing footprint. This will bring real jobs that mean stable careers for working families, giving more young people a chance to proudly call Iowa home. I’ve made it my mission in the Iowa House to make sure we bring opportunities for growth to all parts of the state and delivering this plant follows through on that promise.”

Iowa Senate Majority Leader Mike Klimesh: “For years, we have been passing legislation to help Iowa grow, draw people to our rural communities, and strengthen our state’s economy. Iowa has an opportunity to bring billions of dollars of investment into our state, good quality jobs, and bring people to a part of Iowa looking for growth. These are the kinds of opportunities we have been looking for and that Iowa needs. As we look to remain competitive on the national level, the largest private investment in Iowa history makes it clear our state is open for business.”

Iowa State Rep. Carter Nordman: “$15 BILLION dollar investment in Iowa (largest ever, by far)! Thank you President Donald J. Trump & Governor Kim Reynolds for your leadership on this historic project!”

Iowa State Rep. Austin Harris: “HUGE day for Iowa! The President is announcing a $15 billion investment to build America’s largest steel mill right here in our state — more than 1,750 good-paying jobs for Iowa families. This didn’t happen by accident. For years, Iowa has done the hard work of cutting taxes, slashing red tape, and making it cheaper and faster to build here than almost anywhere else in the country. Companies don’t drop $15 billion on a handshake. They go where the rules are clear, the tax climate is competitive, and the workforce can get the job done. That’s Iowa. We made ourselves the place they wanted to be. Now it will pay off in paychecks, apprenticeships, suppliers, and communities that will feel this for a generation. I am proud of this state and proud of the workers who are about to make history. Iowa is open for business! Let’s get to work!”

Iowa State Rep. Blaine Watkins: “To have one of the largest steel plants in American history built right here in Lee County would be a huge win for our area. It would mean thousands of high-paying, dependable jobs that would give young Iowans a reason to stay, grow their families, and thrive right here in Southeast Iowa. I’ve been fighting for this kind of opportunity in the Iowa House, and I will fight to get this project over the finish line in the Iowa House.”

Iowa State Rep. Matt Rinker: “As a Burlington native, I recognize this announcement for what it is: a once-in-a-generation economic development victory for Iowa. Since being elected to the Iowa House, my priorities have included securing high-paying careers to ensure more people can call Iowa home, and keeping our state competitive in manufacturing apprenticeships and training. The announcement of one of the largest steel plants in American history built right here in Iowa shows that the work we’ve done at the Statehouse, including reducing the tax burden and keeping government spending fiscally responsible is working. In the House, I will fight to deliver this opportunity for my district.”

Lee County (IA) Economic Development Group President and CEO Emily Benjamin: “Today is a great day for eastern Iowa. A $15 billion investment with more than 6,000 construction jobs and 1,750 permanent jobs would be transformational for our region, and we congratulate Mesabi Metallics on today’s announcement.”

Burlington (IA) Mayor Jon Billups: “What’s great for the southeast Iowa region is great for Burlington and what’s great for Burlington is great for southeast Iowa.”

Former Iowa Gov. Terry Branstad: “Steel mill will deliver overwhelming benefits to Iowa”

Mesabi Metallics Chairman Rewant Ruia: “Thank you, Mr. President, for bringing back the importance of building things in America. With the new steel complex in Iowa, we will complete the fully integrated American supply chain from mine to mill. American ore carried on American railroads to an American steel plant powered by American energy, built and operated by an incredibly hardworking and talented American workforce.”

Mesabi Metallics CEO Joe Broking: “This is a major moment for U.S. made steel, combining the highest quality direct-reduction grade iron ore pellet from Minnesota’s Iron Range with the most advanced DRI to EAF steelmaking technology in Iowa to supply the high-quality, all-American steel that our national defense, cars and trucks, shipbuilding, household appliances, energy, and infrastructure depend on.”

Export-Import Bank of the United States Chairman John Jovanovic: “What we’re really talking about today is America’s economic security… What you see here today is private capital flowing in to rebuild America and to build America’s future.”

American Iron and Steel Institute President and CEO Kevin Dempsey: “President Trump’s Section 232 steel tariffs continue to energize the American iron and steel industry. AISI welcomes today’s announcement of another significant new investment in steelmaking in the United States. The sizeable investment by Mesabi Metallics in the new Iowa plant and also its Nashwauk, Minnesota, iron ore mine will further boost U.S. ironmaking and steelmaking capacity, create jobs and strengthen the U.S. economy.”

The Boyd Company Principal John Boyd: “This is coming to Lee County, an area in Iowa really in dire need of revitalization. This is the right project at the right time.”

America First Policy Institute: “President Trump announces a historic $15 BILLION steel plant coming to Iowa — the largest in American history. 6,000 construction jobs. Nearly 2,000 permanent jobs. 10 MILLION tons of American steel produced every year. American steel is BACK.”

President Donald J. Trump is calling on Congress to pass the Protect College Sports Act and bring clarity, stability, and accountability back to college athletics.

Just this weekend, President Trump was at Neyland Stadium for the blockbuster Texas–Tennessee college football game where the crowd erupted in celebration of his attendance. President Trump has tremendous respect for the determination and strength of our great athletes and the traditions that make college sports uniquely American. That is why President Trump has been a champion for this legislation and fighting to protect this proud American institution—supporting hundreds of thousands of student-athletes.

Years of litigation and uncertainty over NIL, eligibility, transfers, and revenue sharing have created a system without clear, consistent rules. The Administration is calling on Congress to establish reasonable guardrails and clear rules and put the Protect College Sports Act on President Trump’s desk.

We cannot turn back the clock, but we can protect the future of college sports and make sure opportunities remain available to student-athletes across America.

President Trump believes wholeheartedly that college sports are worth fighting for—for the athletes, the schools, the fans, and America. Scholarships, roster spots, women’s and Olympic sports, and the traditions millions of Americans cherish are on the line.

President Trump has been leading this fight to protect college sports and America’s athletes.

  • In April, President Trump signed an additional Executive Order to restore order, fairness, and stability to college athletics. He has also brought athletes, coaches, schools, and sports leaders to the White House to address the challenges facing college sports.
  • In 2025, President Trump signed an Executive Order to protect student-athletes and collegiate athletic scholarships and opportunities, including in Olympic and non-revenue programs, and the unique American institution of college sports.
  • The Trump Administration rescinded the Biden Administration’s overly burdensome and profoundly unfair NIL guidance that treated NIL agreements between schools and students like financial aid to be distributed between male and female athletes proportionally under Title IX. 
  • President Trump signed an executive order to protect women’s sports by keeping biological men out of them.
  • President Trump convened a college sports roundtable at the White House with leading sports figures from across the sports landscape to address the future of the industry.

The greatest threat is inaction and uncertainty—Congress must act now to establish clear, fair rules for NIL and protect the future of college athletics.

Today, President Donald J. Trump announced one of the largest steel plants in American history: a $15 billion Mesabi Metallics mill in Iowa. The project will create 1,750 permanent Iowa jobs, support up to 6,000 construction jobs, and is projected to add $95 billion to the U.S. economy over the next decade.

The mill will produce 7.5 million tons of steel per year in its first phase, rising to about ten million tons, using iron ore from Mesabi Metallics’ newly opened Minnesota mine — the first new iron ore mine in the United States in 50 years.

This is the kind of project Democrats spent years making impossible. The Obama Administration blocked a proposed northern Minnesota copper-nickel mine by denying its federal lease renewals in 2016. The Biden Administration canceled those same leases in 2022, then banned mining for 20 years across 225,504 acres of the Superior National Forest. It revoked a key federal water permit for another long-stalled copper-nickel mine. It blocked a 211-mile road in Alaska that would’ve opened a major copper and cobalt district. In 2024, it piled new rules onto taconite iron-ore processing and coke ovens — the plants that feed American steel — while tariff loopholes kept foreign steel flowing in.

President Trump reversed those policies — and American mining is roaring ahead.

  • In 2025, the U.S. surpassed Japan in crude steel production for the first time since 1999 and became the world’s third-largest steel producer. In fact, raw steel output is up 9% since President Trump returned to office.
  • Nearly 6,000 steelworker jobs have been added after almost 10,000 were lost under the prior Administration.
  • American mills now supply 84% of the U.S. finished steel market, up from 77% in 2024.
  • Steel imports are falling as tariffs, permitting reforms, and energy dominance bring production home.
  • New mill orders hit a record $17.3 billion in July 2026; domestic shipments hit a record $16.9 billion that same month.
  • U.S. manufacturing has expanded for eight straight months.
